_volume: Mount a dedicated volume at /data/pmus_shadow (PMUS_SHADOW_STATE). Do NOT reuse /state/pmus-ws (recorder), /state/pmus-sports (collector), /state/pmus-spring (probe), /data/l5_shadow or /data/kalshi_l5. Cohort tallies, dedupe keys and the RAW observation/decision log (PMUS_SHADOW_RAW, /data/pmus_shadow/raw) and the execution-shadow proposal tracker (PMUS_EXEC_STATE, /data/pmus_shadow/execution_shadow.json) live here ONLY. The tracker MUST be durable: a complement posted at 22:52 is judged by trades minutes later, so in-memory tracking would resolve every open proposal to PENDING on each restart and silently reset the denominator. Without this mount the persistence in src/pmus_sports_shadow_breadth.py writes to container-local disk, which survives a process restart and NOT a redeploy -- i.e. not the event that actually erases the evidence.
